label: thm:comparison
assertion: Disjoint P,N on F U; partial s and ℓ with reversed fibers and Fℓ = s ≫ χ.hom; ∃ total g : U ⟶ U with both inverse images zero, and specified-join noncoverage.

label: cor:separator
assertion: No partial conditional s : F U ⟶ F U+F U and partial source lift ℓ exist for a complementary target separator.

label: cor:source-conditionals
assertion: Source diagonal0 τ b and diagonal1 τ b are inseparable when every complementary source pair admits the specified total conditional.

label: prop:disjoint-joins
assertion: The disjoint join of c ≫ i1 and c′ ≫ i0 is a total conditional X ⟶ X+X.

label: prop:interpreted-theory
assertion: Interpretation preserves the range and splitting equations for sentence c : P ⟶ S; a sound factorization through v gives semantic consistency.

label: thm:logical-comparison
assertion: For an interpreted sentence theory t and total θ, construct total g with zero theorem/refutation inverse images; deduce interpreted and source noncoverage.

label: cor:domain-incompleteness
assertion: Every consistent extension t ≥ t₀ has inseparable theorem/refutation idempotents and t ∨ ν*t ≠ 1.

label: thm:first-order-reflection
assertion: Generation is extensive, monotone and idempotent, left adjoint to inclusion of closed sentence theories. Γ(a:A→S)=Gen(im a) is a functor D/S→Th_D(S), left adjoint to J.

label: thm:translation-galois
assertion: Inverse image along σ_S preserves theories; σ#(T)=Gen_Q(σ!T) is left adjoint to σ*. Generation and both composition identities hold.

label: prop:deduction-comparison
assertion: The regular comparison and sentence-derivation morphisms give the two generation identities and commuting adjunction square, a natural KJ₁→J₂L^th, and a restricted right adjoint when L⊣R.

label: thm:free-first-order-adjunction
assertion: Σ_FO:Pair_c(D)⇄FO_V(D):J_FO is an adjunction with atomic-map unit and sentence-interpretation counit.

label: cor:signed-first-order-incompleteness
assertion: For a disjoint pair with consistent free signed theory, that theory is essentially incomplete exactly when the pair is inseparable in the restriction category.

label: lem:partial-slice-turing
assertion: C and C[T]=Par(D/T,Mono) are Turing categories with slice Turing morphism 1_T×τ. The full recursion subcategory R[T] on T×X has Split(R[T])≃C[T].

label: thm:theory-extension
assertion: For t=ui, Σ_i is fully faithful and Σ_i⊣i*⊣Σ_i. Proper i gives failure of essential surjectivity; composition and the sentence/theorem comparison square hold. The sentence family is isomorphic to its pullback and the theorem family lies below the pulled-back theory.

label: thm:associated-incompleteness
assertion: Essential incompleteness of u is equivalent to that of B_U(u). Incompleteness is equivalent to non-totality of the associated Boolean partial morphism; inseparability in C is equivalent to no total extension in C[U]. For every consistent closed extension u≥t of a theory receiving the printed total reduction of an inseparable pair, B_U(u) is essentially incomplete and the associated Boolean partial morphism has no total extension.

label: lem:arithmetized-evaluation
assertion: A deterministic trace coding has PA-provable functionality, evaluation/composition/specialization equations and provably total parameter indices.

label: lem:syntactic-functional-search
assertion: Every Σ₁ Γ has an index e with PA-provable graph soundness and exact existential domain; T-provable functionality gives T-provable uniform graph equivalence.

label: lem:syntactic-total-category
assertion: Predicate presentation P_T ≃ Tot(Split(S_T)); this category is regular with finite disjoint stable coproducts and its monos have partial inverses.

label: lem:st-finite-sigma1
assertion: Finite coded lists of Σ₁ membership conditions have a PA-equivalent Σ₁ definition, including finitely tagged conditions.

label: prop:st-syntax-initiality
assertion: Initial K-algebra on (Tm,Fm), for arbitrary coefficient objects, remains initial in every parameter slice.

label: prop:st-list-initiality
assertion: Initial algebra for Z ↦ 1+V×Z in B_T, stable in every parameter slice.

label: prop:st-substitution-realization
assertion: The list, variable-occurrence and substitution operations agree with the categorical folds. Admissibility is complemented on the object of supported inputs. Arbitrary signature carriers may be c.e. on numerical codes.

label: lem:syntactic-derivation-initiality
assertion: For arbitrary finite typed rule data p_n : R_n ⟶ F^n, q_n : R_n ⟶ F, the inference endofunctor has an initial algebra in B_T/F.

label: thm:syntactic-generated-theory
assertion: The generated first-order theory is the least closed formula/sentence subobject, represented by a source restriction idempotent.

label: prop:model
assertion: F_M : S_T ⟶ Pfn preserves restrictions, zeros, products/coproducts, ranges and finite idempotent joins.

label: lem:switch
assertion: Every complementary pair in S_T has a total conditional; every model sends it to the specified unique section.

label: cor:model-pair
assertion: The model functor satisfies Corollary3.3, giving inseparable source Turing diagonal idempotents.

label: prop:model-total-regular
assertion: G_M on the actual total restriction splitting preserves finite limits, finite coproducts and regular images.

label: lem:semantic-substitution
assertion: Semantic term substitution and formula free-for substitution hold in arbitrary K for realized finite syntax.

label: prop:standard-code-soundness
assertion: Standard-code derivation conclusions factor uniquely through validity V_K; validity and its negation preimage are disjoint.

label: lem:ultrapower-regular
assertion: The ultrapower functor U : Set ⟶ Set preserves finite limits, finite coproducts and regular images.

label: lem:ultrapower-comparison
assertion: Natural isomorphism G_N ⋙ U ≅ G_M : B_PA ⥤ Set; on predicate objects the comparison sends a family to its same arithmetic quotient class.

label: thm:ultrapower-soundness
assertion: Transport standard soundness through ultrapower comparison; prove factorization and semantic consistency.

label: lem:arithmetic-diagonal-representation
assertion: A total numeral-substitution θ : ω ⟶ S represents the actual diagonal idempotents in every M ≡ N.

label: lem:arithmetic-proof-search
assertion: A partial Γ-proof-search ℓ_Γ in S_PA has reversed theorem/refutation fibers in every model where the predicates are disjoint.

label: thm:arithmetic-internal-comparison
assertion: Incomplete source and standard/ultrapower interpretations, with total g producing sentences undecidable from Γ.

label: cor:arithmetic
assertion: Theorem/refutation sets of every consistent c.e. PA extension are recursively inseparable; all consistent c.e. extensions are incomplete.

label: prop:arithmetic-theory-fibers
assertion: Every numeral pullback of the actual family conclusion is an initial inference algebra; the sentence square is cartesian and its image is the Γ_e sentence theory.

label: thm:uniform-independent-sentences
assertion: One total q : E ⟶ S gives an independent sentence for every consistent Γ_e.

label: prop:numerical-structure
assertion: Tot(Split(Rec)) ≃ C_rec, with regular/extensive C_rec, partial inverses of monos and Par(C_rec,Mono) ≃ Split(Rec).

label: prop:arithmetic-theory-realization
assertion: First-order syntax/list algebras and finite-derivation initial algebras exist in C_rec and are stable under parameters.

label: lem:arithmetic-signed-theory
assertion: The free first-order theory generated by the arithmetic diagonal pair is internally consistent and essentially incomplete.

label: cor:arithmetic-associated-categories
assertion: Every consistent internal extension of the free theory on the arithmetic diagonal pair satisfies the associated-category extension and incompleteness conclusions.

label: lem:miller-unanimity
assertion: One oracle program computes τ_z with the same domain and values for every binary representation of z.

label: prop:miller-category
assertion: E_a has recursion structure, ranges, restriction coproducts, finite compatible joins, local connectedness and weak choice.

label: lem:miller-cut-reduction
assertion: An ordinary total recursive h pulls L_a,R_a back exactly to diagonal A₀,A₁.

label: cor:miller-cuts-inseparable
assertion: L_a,R_a are inseparable internally although every individual oracle representation computes a separator.

label: prop:miller-theory-realization
assertion: D_a is regular/extensive with partial inverses of monos and partial-map equivalence; parameterized syntax/list/derivation initiality.

label: lem:miller-parameterized-deduction
assertion: Miller syntax and initial derivation algebras exist for arbitrary semidecidable nullary coefficients and axiom families in every parameter slice.

label: thm:miller-incompleteness
assertion: In the ordered-field language with constants cₙ, T_a is the deductive closure of the real closed ordered field axioms and the strict rational bounds on cₙ. Every consistent extension in that language whose axioms are semidecided by one program under every binary name of a has inseparable theorem and refutation domains and is incomplete.

label: cor:miller-associated-categories
assertion: Every consistent internal extension of the expanded Miller field theory satisfies the associated-category theorem and has the no-total-extension witness.

label: prop:endpoint
assertion: E_j : A ⟶ K preserves restriction/range/product/coproduct/join structure; endpoints send the specified τ to a Turing morphism.

label: prop:fork-syntax-initial
assertion: S is initial for P(Z)=V+Z+Z² in the total fork category.

label: prop:fork-proof-initial
assertion: The typed finite derivation H-algebra is initial in E/S, with unique natural computable folds.

label: thm:fork-proof-presentation
assertion: The conclusion range is the least closed c.e. subfunctor, is consistent, and contains positive/negative atomic inputs.

label: thm:cosheaf-observation
assertion: Consistent extension families give internally inseparable theorem/refutation idempotents, recursively inseparable N² observations, covariant extension functor, and EACH endpoint theory incomplete.

label: cor:cosheaf-essential-incompleteness
assertion: Every consistent c.e.-axiomatized extension of either endpoint theory is incomplete.

label: prop:fork-first-order-realization
assertion: The fork total category has first-order syntax and initial finite-derivation algebras for arbitrary nullary coefficients, stable in every parameter slice.

label: prop:fork-first-order-conservative
assertion: The generated first-order sentence theory is consistent and essentially incomplete, restricts to the original propositional theory, and has no consistent complete c.e.-axiomatized extension in the endpoint language at either endpoint.

label: cor:fork-associated-theories
assertion: Every consistent internal extension of the first-order fork theory satisfies the associated-category extension and incompleteness conclusions.

label: def:categorical-syntax
assertion: A named-variable syntax is a parameter-stable initial K-algebra plus parameter-stable initial list algebra.

label: def:sentence-object
assertion: Sentence S ↪ Fm is the pullback of the occurrence-list map along nil : 1 ⟶ List V.

label: prop:categorical-substitution
assertion: Parameterized initiality constructs term substitution and option-valued formula substitution; its success pullback is complemented.

label: def:deductively-closed
assertion: Closed subobject means an H-algebra structure on a mono T ↪ F in D/F.

label: thm:least-theorem-subobject
assertion: The regular image of an initial inference-algebra conclusion is the least closed subobject.

label: thm:first-order-theory
assertion: Initial H_A gives least first-order generated theory; sentence image equals the pullback of its formula image.

label: lem:range-regular-image
assertion: A total regular-image factorization f=e≫m with partial inverse r of m has range(f)=r≫m=rst r.

label: prop:fork-cosheaves
assertion: Restriction/extension equivalence CoSh(X,Set) ≃ Set^J; value at X is the pushout, with component inverses.

label: prop:fork-total
assertion: C_rec and E have finite limits/coproducts; E regular/extensive with component mono/image characterization.

label: prop:fork-structure
assertion: Par(E,Mono) is split/prodominical with products/coproducts/ranges/choice and finite inverse-image joins, product ranges and total pullback stability.

label: prop:fork-local
assertion: A is locally connected.

label: lem:fork-dominance
assertion: Every Y in E has a total restriction monomorphism into V with a partial inverse.

label: lem:fork-frames
assertion: V ≅ V×V, V ≅ V+V and V ≅ V# as natural total computable morphisms.

label: thm:fork-turing
assertion: τ : V×V ⟶ V is Turing for arbitrary parameter fork Y and arbitrary partial natural F.

label: prop:fork-recursion
assertion: Generated full recursion subcategory includes V/products/coproducts/nonempty words; inclusion is range and splitting equivalent to A.

label: cor:fork-karoubi
assertion: All idempotents in A split. The restriction equivalence from Kar(R_X) to A extends the inclusion up to natural isomorphism.

label: prop:fork-distinction
assertion: R_X is not restriction-equivalent to Rec; V lacks decidable equality in E.

label: prop:missing-lift
assertion: Oracle-domain source C_K has recursion/range structure and faithful F; source diagonal separated, required conditional absent, disjoint arrows have no common upper bound.

label: thm:faithful
assertion: Faithful family F_T : S_T ⟶ ∏_(M⊨T,carrier N) Pfn, preserving stated structure with split/locally-connected/choice target and nonzero identity.

label: cor:pair
assertion: Source diagonal pair remains the identically defined inseparable pair under every consistent theory extension.
